transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. It's nice to meet you too. 

Well, I decided to come in because... what really scared me enough to ask for help is that I keep having these mornings where I think it might be easier if I just didn't wake up. I mean, I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But just having that thought on a regular basis... it was enough to make me realize I should probably talk to a doctor.
Have you ever had a distinct period when your mood was unusually elevated or irritable?
No, I haven't. I've just been feeling really down, not unusually high or irritable like that.
How long have you been feeling down most days?
Well, it's been going on for about a month now. It started right after my sister died unexpectedly. So, yeah, about a month.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?

Yes, I have. I mean, I still make myself show up for things, like my book club or the dance night. But lately, I just sit there feeling like I'm behind a pane of glass. It's hard to explain, but I just feel disconnected from it all. And even my hobbies at home... my garden and cooking for the neighbors, they just don't give me that little lift they used to.
How has your sleep been since this began?

It hasn't been very good. I seem to just fall asleep in bits and pieces now. And then I'll wake up way before dawn, with my mind already turning. Once I'm awake like that, I usually can't get settled again before the day even starts.
How has your energy been since your sister died?

It's been pretty low, honestly. Um... even just doing simple errands leaves me feeling completely worn out. Like, just getting some papers together for the Cultural Center takes it out of me. It just feels like my body is moving through thick mud most of the time.
Are there still moments when you can genuinely feel pleasure or emotional connection, or has the sadness and disconnection been present almost all the time regardless of what is happening?

It's... pretty much all the time, honestly. I can't really think of a moment lately where I felt genuinely happy or connected. Even if something nice is happening around me, that disconnected feeling just kind of stays put. It doesn't really lift, regardless of what I'm doing.
